rooms.name: Dedicated artifact stair
rooms.stairDetail: Independent garage–B2 stair; 5.8 m rise, 36 risers in two flights, 1.4 m clear width / landings, 0.27 m going. South-side landings connect to garage and B2 dirty arrival.

B1.note: Garage remains 408 m² in its V8 footprint, with floor at -9.80 m and 8 m clear height. It is 4 m below the clean B1 lobby (-5.80 m). Garage → wash → gowning → full 24-riser transfer stair → main-stair lobby. A different 8 × 8 m stair descends directly to B2 dirty arrival and decon. Freight has one garage stop, at -9.80 m, with no redundant lobby-level stop. The boarded 280 m² wing shares the garage floor but has a 4 m ceiling and unused overhead void.

B2.note: Cargo: east through-car freight door → intake/scanner → analysis → artifact store → containment. Clean staff: main stair → clean return → gowning → research hall → analysis. Garage personnel: independent artifact stair → dirty arrival → undress → wash → gowning. Dirty lab/intake exit uses its own return to wash; the west freight door serves dirty gear deliberately. No Research Hall–Intake door and no Analysis–Test Observation shortcut. Test Observation remains reached through Containment.

designReferences: Säynätsalo: protected outdoor court and differentiated thresholds

Carpenter Center: multiple approaches and interlocking volumes

designSequence: Service routes reserve 1.5 m clear height × 0.8 m clear width for crouching; pipes stay outside that route. Controller nominal clearance is 1.23 m crouched / 1.80 m standing; runtime traversal is untested.
Normal module: 4.0 m occupied + 1.5 m service + 0.3 m slab = 5.8 m.
Garage: floor -9.80 m; 8 m clear. Clean B1 lobby -5.80 m; 4 m full stair between them.
B2 -15.60 m and B3 -21.40 m keep complete 4 m-clear floors beneath the garage.
Three distinct vertical routes: NW main stair, dedicated artifact stair, freight shaft.
Boarded sections stay 280 m² B1 + 80 m² L1; upper room layouts are retained.

approaches.note: West vehicle opening at dropped garage floor -9.80 m; 5 m clear opening. Hillside / ramp gradient and ground interface remain schematic.
V7 east entrance retained. No new west pedestrian entrance.
